versions.name: Kerr Scout Ranch at Slippery Falls

features.note: A council ring with two campfire rings, a wooden deck stage and log seating for five hundred.
A large swimming dock with divided swim areas on a thirty-acre lake, plus a boat house and pavilions.
Central restrooms and showers near the dining halls, plus a shower house on the east side of the camping area.
A muzzle-loading rifle option alongside the smallbore program.
Cabin blocks of four-bed rooms with mattresses, plus a bunk house.
Aluminium canoes with paddles and life jackets provided.
A rustic outdoor chapel seating one hundred on benches; a chapel period opens most camp mornings.
An indoor climbing wall suited to younger Scouts alongside the outdoor tower.
A fifty-foot tower with three molded climbing faces and one dedicated rappelling face.
Two identical dining halls, each seating three hundred.
Fly fishing is offered alongside the standard fishing program; fishing is not permitted inside the aquatics area.
Basketry, leatherwork, pottery, wood carving and Indian lore.
Whitewater-style kayaks with helmets provided.
Enclosed summer houses and a council house in one village area, plus open pavilions elsewhere on the ranch.
Several campsites are set with tent platforms shaded by pines and oaks.
A covered range with eight firing stations for smallbore rifle.
Two natural granite sites with climbing and rappelling routes up to twenty-five feet.
A two-station shotgun range.
A thirty-acre lake with a swimming dock and boat house; a spring-fed creek and waterfall run through the property.
Metalworking is offered alongside welding.

versions.summary: Last Frontier Council's Scouts BSA resident summer camp near Tishomingo, Oklahoma.
